notes: Four `added` units, each checked against the source: no conjunction in the clause for the opening *that* (rule 55), no object morphemes for the *thee* and *it* of *cause thee to hear it*, and no suffix on אָזְנָיִם for *thine*.
The construct relation of הַשְׁמָעוּת אָזְנָיִם is recast with *with*, which rule 19 places on the rectum.
